title: URLs to look up in the Wayback Machine
description: Send pages, hosts or full links. Each URL the archive holds history for becomes one paid row; a URL it never saw comes back free with a reason.

urls.title: URLs
urls.description: Pages to look up: a bare host such as example.com, a host with a path such as apify.com/pricing, or a full http/https link. The last line in the default list has no snapshots, so it comes back free.

maxSnapshotsPerUrl.title: Latest versions per URL
maxSnapshotsPerUrl.description: How many of the newest distinct versions to return for each URL, collapsed by content digest so identical copies do not repeat. Default 20, maximum 100.

from.title: Window start (optional)
from.description: Only count snapshots taken on or after this moment. Format YYYY, YYYYMM, YYYYMMDD or YYYYMMDDhhmmss. An empty value means the whole history; a malformed value stops the run before any request.

to.title: Window end (optional)
to.description: Only count snapshots taken on or before this moment, same formats as the window start.

maxUrls.title: Maximum URLs per run
maxUrls.description: How many lines of the list this run reads. Default and maximum 200; a line past the cap comes back as a free NOT_CHECKED_CAP row that names the cap.
